news.title: OpenSGolf 0.7 released
news.text: An optional second course of 18 more holes on the same land, forward and middle tees picked by each golfer's skill, a flyover of any hole from Hole Stats, double-click to load a save, and longer translations that fit their boxes.

news.title: OpenSGolf 0.6
news.text: Smoother play with no more short freezes, faster Enhanced graphics in the browser, HD graphics made from your own SimGolf files (beta), new cartoon faces for the free graphics, and the interface at the screen's edges on wide screens.

news.title: OpenSGolf 0.5
news.text: Bring your original SimGolf saves across, read landing-map heat maps, pick a bigger text size, and watch windows glow at night and sprinklers at dawn.

0.7.note: Once your 18 holes are open, build 18 more on the same land (new games).
Tab with the Tees tool places them; golfers pick theirs by skill (new games).
Hole Stats gets a Fly over button: click a hole's flag to open it.
A celebrity's name shows over a home site only while you point at it.

0.7.line: Double-click a save to load it
0.7.note: Or double-tap it on a touch screen.
Longer translations fit, replays in problem reports, controller fixes.
